title: Inclusive Health Outreach in Wakiso
summary: A youth-led outreach delivered accessible health information to over 300 participants in two months.
outcome: 85% of participants reported increased confidence in accessing health services.

title: Livelihoods Pathway for New Entrepreneurs
summary: A mentorship cohort supported youth entrepreneurs with training, tools, and market linkages.
outcome: 18 youth-led enterprises launched with ongoing peer support.
